what: Solventum is the health care business spun out of 3M in 2024. It makes surgical tapes and wound dressings, sterilisation and infection-prevention products, dental materials, and software that turns doctors' notes into hospital billing codes.
customers: Hospitals, surgery centres, dental practices and health systems, buying through group purchasing contracts.
money: wound care, surgical drapes, sterilisation and IV site care
fillings, bonding agents, crowns and clear aligners
clinical documentation and medical coding software
moat: Products written into hospital procedure protocols and nurses' training, where switching brands means retraining staff and revalidating a process.
risks: Revenue has been flat around $8.3B for four years, so this is not a growing business today
97 times earnings for a company whose free cash flow was slightly negative over the last twelve months
$5.2B of debt taken on at the spin-off, and payments still owed to 3M
opportunities: Analysts see about 15% upside and the shares trade at 1.8 times sales
An 18.7% operating margin on products hospitals reorder continuously rather than buy once
Selling the Purification and Filtration arm raises cash to pay down the spin-off debt
watch: Organic revenue growth, which has to turn positive before the margin story matters.
